newsitem.title: USA: BellAtlantic, NYNEX to cut 10,000 - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: BellAtlantic, NYNEX to cut 10,000 - WSJ.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp and NYNEX Corp expect to reduce their combined 137,000 workforce by at least 10,000 employees within five years, the Wall Street Journal said in Tuesday's electronic edition.
This was three times higher than the companies' initial estimate, the newspaper said.

According to people familiar with the companies' employment plans, the new figure indicates the companies face a larger consolidation than first thought as they complete a planned $20 billion stock merger.

Bell Atlantic spokesman Jay Grossman was quoted by the Journal as declining to comment on the new job cut estimate but he also declined to reiterate a previous statement in which the companies forecast 3,000 job losses.

According to people familiar with the matter, 3,000 jobs, mostly non-union, would be cut in the first three years while larger reductions would occur between three to five years out, the Journal said.
These people were quoted as saying Bell Atlantic and NYNEZ did not have a definitive plan worked out yet but at least 10,000 job cuts was a reasonable estimate within five years.
